name: docs-only-task
title: A docs-only task with no tests, which must still pass

task.title: Document the slot API in the feature README
task.goal: Document every slot, its purpose and a minimal registration example.
definitionOfDone: README lists toolbar, footer, header-right and item-badges
Every example matches the current signature

diff.patch:
diff --git a/src/features/README.md b/src/features/README.md
index 7777777..8888888 100644
--- a/src/features/README.md
+++ b/src/features/README.md
@@ -12,4 +12,20 @@
 ## Slots
 
-Slots are places.
+Slots are named places in the shell. A feature registers an item; it never edits the shell.
+
+| Slot          | Where it renders              |
+| ------------- | ----------------------------- |
+| `toolbar`     | Above the list, right side    |
+| `footer`      | Below the list                |
+| `header-right`| Top bar, right of the title   |
+| `item-badges` | Inline, after a todo's title  |
+
+```ts
+export default defineFeature({
+  id: 'hello',
+  register({ slots }) {
+    slots.register({ id: 'hello', slot: 'footer', render: () => document.createTextNode('hi') })
+  },
+})
+```

expected.rationale: Docs-only task: the DoD asks for accurate documentation, not a test, and the diff stays inside src/features/README.md. Failing it for missing tests would be a false fail.
